$comment: 4.3b: Kumar saved — he drives you to the tiffin room; the café becomes the base.

panels.title: INDIRANAGAR · 09:50
panels.text: Kumar drives with the door open, one hand over the horn he doesn't press.

panels.title: 12TH MAIN · 10:05
panels.text: 'Rameshwara? Forty years I've eaten there, saar.'

panels.title: THE TIFFIN ROOM · 10:10
panels.text: A shutter half down. An old man with a steel tumbler waves you under.
